commitNote: The harness and loadtest/competitors/ at this commit; the tree had no other changes to them.

environmentChanges.change: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range widened from '32768 60999' to '1024 65535' during repetition 1 (after its connection ramps), so that sockets left in TIME_WAIT by one proxy's ramp do not exhaust the ports of the next proxy's ramp; repetitions 2 and 3 ran with the wider range. Each run's results.json records the range in effect (environment.limits).

rejected.reason: Contaminated: it ran (04:22-05:12 UTC) while other sessions on the machine ran CPU-bound loops and test suites, before the host monitor existed; the harness's per-core samples show other work on the proxy's CPU averaging 12-75% depending on the scenario, and its connection ramps hit the ephemeral-port limit (see environmentChanges). It was repeated as rep4, with the same jar, settings and proxy order.

repeated.command: REPS=1 OUT=loadtest/results/perf-rep4 PUBLISH=0 loadtest/competitors/run-all.sh (the same jar, built at acf503e, and the same settings and proxy order as rep1; moved here as rep4)
